boxes.title: More on the parliamentary model
items: PM = **chief spokesperson** of Government; heads Council of Ministers
Britain: ministers **must be MPs**; ==legal responsibility== of ministers (India neither)
Both: PM grown so much = =="Prime Ministerial Government"==
UK (**Keir Starmer** resignation): ruling party can replace PM; India: loss of **Lok Sabha confidence** needed

boxes.title: Other contrasts
head: Point
Detail
rows: May not sit in legislature (**US secretaries do not**)
President + PM may be from ==different parties==
India: **three lists** (strong centre); USA: enumerated federal powers
Written Constitution, federal, judicial review, **Fundamental Rights / Bill of Rights**

boxes.title: Debate extras
items: Parliamentary merit: executive **continuously accountable**; demerit: ministers ==not always specialists==
**Governor's discretion** also rests on parliamentary logic
